IR_maenes_reply_10.reference_only_text: Zarya-1, this is Sunray. Do you read, over?

IR_maenes_reply_115.reference_only_text: Can you bring the defence system back on-line?

IR_maenes_reply_105.reference_only_text: Help us, Commander. Our systems have been sabotaged - we can't defend ourselves.

IR_maenes_reply_20.reference_only_text: Copy that Sunray, this is Zarya-1. The attack's already in progress - we need your help!

IR_landers_reply_120.reference_only_text: We've managed to get the defence systems back on-line. Watch out for cannon fire!

IR_maenes_reply_30.reference_only_text: What happened to the navy? Are they on their way?

IR_maenes_reply_40.reference_only_text: I don't know! We have a mass of hostile ships and the Maenes defence grid is out of action. They're completely overwhemled!

IR_maenes_reply_285.reference_only_text: We've managed to get the defence systems back on-line. Watch out for cannon fire!

IR_landers_reply_15.reference_only_text: Good work, Commander. Now let's finish off the rest of the SDF fleet.

IR_maenes_reply_50.reference_only_text: Hold on, Zarya-1, I'm on my way.

IR_maenes_reply_255.reference_only_text: We think we've regained control of the cannons - hold on!

IR_maenes_reply_80.reference_only_text: Concentrate on the enemy Assault Landers. They've been tasked to assault Maenes Station.

IR_maenes_reply_90.reference_only_text: Roger that. Maenes Station, this is the police. Patch me through to Colonez Ruiz immediately!

IR_maenes_reply_135.reference_only_text: We have to get them firing if we're to defend Maenes!

IR_maenes_reply_125.reference_only_text: We're trying! We have the targets on our radar but we can't get the cannons to engage.

IR_landers_reply_65.reference_only_text: We think we've regained control of the cannons - hold on!

IR_sdf_transport_report.reference_only_text: Zarya-1, this is Sunray. All assault landers have been destroyed.

IR_sdf_destroyed.reference_only_text: Well done, we've destroyed the SDF's flagship. Let's meet back at Maenes Station.

IR_LOA_6.reference_only_text:
Back at the headquarters of QuiCo Pharmaceuticals you find Colonel Ruiz waiting for you along with a group of senior security personnel.

"Excellent work, Commander. With your help our forces have managed to repel the SDF's attack."

"What happened to the navy? I thought the task force had been put on alert."

"It seems they've only just arrived at the witchpoint - luckily Major Cherkasova assured us that assistance was on its way."

"I'm only glad I could help. Now, we need to send an urgent dispatch to Galcop - we don't know if Sirius has anything else planned. Tell High Command to divert the task force to their corporate headquarters in Tevebebi. We mustn't let Sirius attempt a counterattack."

"I'll get onto it right away, Commander."

IR_waitforinfo_brief.reference_only_text: Await further instructions form GalCop HQ.

playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_10: Zarya-1, this is Sunray. Do you read?
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_20: Copy, Sunray. This is Zarya-1. The orbital station is under attack; engage the designated SDF fleet.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_30: Has Task Force Juliet reached the sector?
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_40: Its arrival is not confirmed. Hostile ships are approaching and the defence grid has lost proactive targeting.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_80: Concentrate on the eight designated assault transports. Their target is Maenes main orbital station.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_90: Maenes Control, connect us to Colonel Ruiz through the orbital liaison.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_105: Commander, the grid has been sabotaged. Its automatic targeting is offline; individual batteries may still return fire.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_115: Can the station restore the grid controllers?
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_125: Our tracking is working. The station engineers are recovering automatic engagement control.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_135: Keep engaging the SDF fleet while the station team restores the surviving batteries.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_255: The station team is recovering the defence controllers. Stand by.
playable_text_overrides.IR_maenes_reply_285: The surviving grid controllers are responding. Keep clear of cannon fire.
playable_text_overrides.IR_landers_reply_15: All eight designated assault transports are destroyed. Engage the remaining designated flagship.
playable_text_overrides.IR_landers_reply_65: The station team is recovering the defence controllers. Stand by.
playable_text_overrides.IR_landers_reply_120: The surviving grid controllers are responding. Keep clear of cannon fire.
playable_text_overrides.IR_sdf_transport_report: Zarya-1, this is Sunray. All eight designated assault transports are destroyed.
playable_text_overrides.IR_sdf_destroyed: The eight designated transports and the SDF flagship are destroyed. Regroup with Cherkasova at Maenes main orbital station.
playable_text_overrides.IR_LOA_6: At Maenes main orbital station, you and Cherkasova report through the QuiCo security liaison. Colonel Ruiz confirms receipt of the destruction records for eight assault transports and the Imperator. He thanks you for repelling the designated SDF attack. The surviving escorts, station damage and grid condition remain their actual recorded state. Ruiz reports that Task Force Juliet was delayed; this is not proof that its ships have arrived. You request an urgent orbital dispatch to GalCop High Command, asking it to monitor Sirius and divert the task force towards its corporate orbital communications at Tevebebi. Ruiz agrees to transmit the request. Await further intelligence; no extra fleet, ground operation or journey to Tevebebi is created by this report.
playable_text_overrides.IR_sources_brief_3: Regroup with Cherkasova at Maenes main orbital station for the confirmed security report.
playable_text_overrides.IR_waitforinfo_brief: Await further GalCop intelligence at a main orbital station in Galaxy 8.
